triadic_descent.CIF: the exact G branch family supplies every admissible infinitesimal perturbation direction, branch identity, covariance direction, memory and ancestry compatible with H_G_to_HU
triadic_descent.QV: apply the first Frechet variation of the exact G evolution law, restricted to the constraint-preserving physical tangent quotient, to propagate admissible perturbations
triadic_descent.RFL: freeze the resulting typed propagator family, constraint/gauge contract, uncertainty pushforward, ancestry and hash as the immutable universal operator consumed later by HI

typed_operator.generator: K_HU[b,eta] = P_b D L_G[rho_G^b(eta)] P_b, where L_G is the exact parent G generator/master-law, D is its first variation, and P_b is the exact finite projector/quotient representative onto the constraint-preserving non-gauge tangent space. Unresolved G branch coordinates remain symbolic arguments.
typed_operator.propagator: U_HU[b;eta2,eta1] is the unique finite time-ordered solution dU/deta=K_HU[b,eta] U with U(eta1,eta1)=I on each admitted finite branch; composition U(eta3,eta1)=U(eta3,eta2)U(eta2,eta1) and superposition follow on the declared linear domain.
typed_operator.domain: For each admitted G branch b, let X_G^b be the finite relational G state and T_b X_G its tangent space. Let C_b deltaX=0 denote the linearized exact G conservation/constraint ledger and let G_b denote pure representation/gauge directions. The physical linear domain is V_b=ker(C_b)/im(G_b); HU is the disjoint branch-indexed family V_HU=union_b {b}xV_b. No I geometry or realized expansion coordinate is part of V_HU.
typed_operator.codomain: same branch-indexed physical tangent quotient at the output G clock coordinate
typed_operator.linearity_domain: first-order tangent perturbations within each finite G branch for which the first variation exists, restricted to the exact constraint-preserving non-gauge quotient

gauge_frame_contracts.constraint: P_b^2=P_b and range(P_b) subset ker(C_b); therefore K_HU=P_b K_HU P_b maps the physical tangent subspace to itself. Gauge/representation-equivalent inputs are identified in the quotient and cannot become distinct physical outputs.
gauge_frame_contracts.frame_clock: HU inherits only the G clock family and branch labels from H_G_to_HU. Realized I geometry, scale factor, horizon, distance, metric, observed expansion history, or any background-specific numerical value is forbidden input.

operator_uncertainty.law: For a fixed symbolic branch/operator realization, Sigma_out=U Sigma_in U^T. Operator uncertainty is retained as the branch-indexed family induced by inherited G covariance plus representation, numerical and unresolved-branch uncertainty; HU does not collapse that family by fitting a realized background.

parent_covariance.law: Sigma_G=J_G Sigma_F J_G^T + Sigma_process + Sigma_representation + Sigma_numeric + Sigma_branch with every added covariance term PSD

parameters: positive bound-state spectral gaps B_AqLambda on admitted branches
admitted route amplitudes W_jr/Phi_jr and occupation factors
branch_family.selection_rule: retain every admitted G branch and unresolved source-owned coordinate; no I value, public target, familiar transfer table, or empirical resemblance may select or tune the operator
branch_family.linearity_domain: first-order tangent perturbations within each finite G branch for which the first variation exists, restricted to the exact constraint-preserving non-gauge quotient
branch_family.nonuniqueness_policy: branch identity and unresolved G coordinates remain explicit arguments through HU and into HI

restart.contract: reconstruct HU from exact H_G_to_HU + FROZEN_DERIVATION_SPEC + frozen implementation; no I values admitted

parent.contract: G consumes H_F_to_G_v2; no conventional recombination initial condition may replace it

parent_restart.G_checkpoint: full atomic/radiative branch identity + operator parameters + solver witness state
